text: APPROVE: Recounting the original gives 17 (while +1, four catches at +2, two foreach at +2, the `if` at +3, `&&` +1), and the refactored method scores about 12. The eager `[.. enumerate()]` inside the `try` keeps the same exception handling and skip-on-failure behaviour, and the `CHA0004` pragma stays around the catches, so I see no build or behaviour regression.
